item.title: ‘Worse than I thought’: Braun visits Lake Village to see tornado damage
item.description: Gov. Mike Braun surveyed the damage caused by a deadly tornado in Lake Village, Indiana, and is discussing potential disaster assistance with federal officials.

item.title: #18 Purdue beats Northwestern in Big Ten Tournament
item.description: CHICAGO (WISH) — The No. 18 Purdue Boilermakers kicked off their trip to the Big Ten Men’s Basketball Tournament with a bang against the Northwestern Wildcats. item.title: Noblesville expects economic boost as new host of Horizon League hoops tourneys
item.description: The Horizon League has chosen Noblesville's The Arena at Innovation Mile as the host site for its men's and women's basketball championships from 2027-2031. The hope is to create a full tournament experience for fans and teams, and provide an economic boost to the city.

item.title: Rescue underway after US military refueling aircraft crashes in Iraq
item.description: An American military refueling plane crashed in Iraq while taking part in the operation against Iran, with rescue efforts underway and no immediate reports of casualties.

item.title: Man dies after being struck by semi at Greensburg intersection
item.description: A 69-year-old man was hit by a semitractor at a State Road 3 intersection in Greensburg, Indiana, on Thursday afternoon. He died later at Eskenazi Hospital in Indianapolis.

item.title: Body found in academic building at Purdue University, coroner says
item.description: A dead body was found on Purdue University's campus Monday evening, and the Coroner's Office is working to identify the person with an autopsy scheduled for Friday.

item.title: Police find man with trauma dead in Westfield home
item.description: A man was found dead with trauma Thursday night in a Westfield, Indiana, home. Police are seeking information on the suspicious death.
